verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs describe background automation: Seer Autofix scans incoming issues, finds root causes, automates triage, and can open fix PRs, while Alerts act on pre-defined rules by creating tickets, calling webhooks, or triggering integrations. These are fixed, event-triggered automations rather than general user-built autonomous workflows, and they are evidenced only by brief vendor claims. missing for 10: user-configurable custom agent automations beyond triage/fix and alert rules, recurring or scheduled automation runs, documentation of how much Autofix runs without human approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage. PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
